_comment: NOMINAL values derived from maze_design/maze_256x226.json tag_pads, NOT caliper measurements. Each x_m/y_m is the lower-left of the tag's square OUTER BLACK footprint in the plate frame (origin lower-left, +x right, +y up), computed as pad centre minus half the 18 mm tag. rotation_deg is counter-clockwise in that frame. Wrong values here corrupt the pose invisibly: solvePnP fits whatever geometry it is given and still reports a small reprojection residual. Replace with caliper measurements of the installed tags.
z_note: Tags are GLUED to the top of the corner pads. The pad top is 8 mm above the playing surface (11 mm print height minus the 3 mm floor) and the tag is 3 mm thick, so the tag face sits at z = 0.011 m. All four shift equally, so alpha/beta are unaffected, but ball coordinates are not: the ray/plane intersection depends on this value.
